definitions.explanation: Yarn or thread made from wool or other fibers, used for knitting or crocheting.

examples.japanese: {毛糸|けいと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編|あ}んだ→編む：00002_amu⟧。
examples.english: I knitted a sweater with yarn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手芸店|しゅげいてん}→手芸店：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{毛糸|けいと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought yarn at the craft store.
The cat is playing with a ball of yarn.
